title: Checkpoint mobile usability and understood-point history audit
scope: static mobile readiness + browser-free interaction wiring + legacy detector performance indication

mobileChecks.name: responsive-breakpoints
mobileChecks.evidence: 680px and 430px breakpoints; summary grid collapses and narrow footer stacks.

mobileChecks.name: input-font-size
mobileChecks.evidence: textarea font-size 17px, avoiding common iOS focus zoom trigger below 16px.

mobileChecks.name: touch-targets
mobileChecks.evidence: primary mobile controls, close, drawer actions, restore actions and mini controls have min-height 44px.

mobileChecks.name: drawer-mobile-scroll
mobileChecks.evidence: drawer has overflow-y:auto, -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch, overscroll-behavior:contain, 92dvh fallback, body scroll lock.

mobileChecks.name: safe-area
mobileChecks.evidence: shell and drawer use env(safe-area-inset-bottom) padding.

mobileChecks.name: fixed-width-risk
mobileChecks.evidence: content uses max-width:920px; fixed widths are only legend swatches and close button. No fixed content column width.

mobileChecks.name: one-character-inline-hit
mobileChecks.evidence: single-character inline marks remain physically narrow, but every active point is also available through large checklist items. Inline marks use generous reading line-height.

mobileChecks.name: long-sample-legacy-detector
mobileChecks.evidence: browser-free V8 benchmark on 877-character Abe sample: 500 runs / 1011ms, average ~2.022ms per detect. This is not a phone benchmark but shows no obvious algorithmic blow-up.

mobileChecks.name: live-device-runtime
mobileChecks.evidence: deployment workflow publishes only pushes to main. checkpoint-main cannot be honestly device-tested at the public Pages URL until integration or an explicit preview deployment.

behavior: 「ここはわかる」で隠したpoints are listed under the checklist.
Each row shows surface, category, and a short context snippet with the target bracketed.
Each row has a 44px mobile restore button.
All understood points can be restored at once.
History is aria-live for assistive feedback.
History is scoped to the current text; changing the text clears dismissed keys automatically.
The panel stays hidden when there are no understood points.

wiringAudit.eventTargets: all newly added static IDs exist in index.html
wiringAudit.dynamicTargetNote: focusAnswerResult is intentionally generated dynamically by ui3.js

deploymentFinding.consequence: checkpoint-main changes are not visible on the current public Pages URL until the integration/deployment step.
deploymentFinding.safety: Do not manually deploy checkpoint-main over production Pages without explicit coordination, because main is used by the other koten team.

nextDeviceSmoke: After safe production integration, open /checkpoint/ on iPhone Safari.
Paste or load sample 3 and sample 4.
Tap a one-character mark and a checklist item.
Open/scroll/close drawer; confirm background does not scroll.
Tap 「ここはわかる」 on 2-3 points; confirm history appears below checklist.
Restore one item, then restore all.
Change the input text and confirm understood history clears.
Rotate portrait/landscape and confirm no horizontal overflow.
Confirm normal URL does not show shadow debug; ?debug=shadow is developer-only.
